{{Otheruses|Cabal}}
'''The Cabal''' was a series of explorations founded by [[Deamos Na-Coth]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to search for the legendary planet [[Exo (planet)|Exo]]. Each exploration consisted of a massive [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] with a primitive [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Most of the Cabal expeditions ended in disaster - mutinies, attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], caught in [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]], hyperdrive malfunctions or simple disappearances. One ship, the ''[[Exocros Cabal]]'', founded a society on the planet [[Exocron]] in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]].
